policy_inputs: Original hypothesis string only plus fixed own-source/policy hashes; no document, ID, label, model output or corpus lookup
causal_control_required: Original and expanded native queries use the same document index, search configuration, reader and packing; lexical uses exactly the same expanded query. Actual runtime provenance still requires separate source/trace audit.
proof_scope: Exposed engineering only; explicitly disabled for DEV. No proof benchmark-transfer claim.
premeasurement_redesign: The first proof-primary proposal had guaranteed zero coverage of all3 modal NDA hypotheses. Root prospectively added the single query treatment and native_original causal control before any new input projection, model/native or labels. No scored variant selection occurred.
authorization_limit: Approves the exact query function/policy definition only; not yet the candidate integration, raw-output integrity, scorer or model execution.
